name: Wonderland
tagline: A tea party of sound. Dress code: as curious as you dare.

cover.alt: The Warehouse at Emperors Palace during Wonderland: the main stage glowing red and blue above a packed floor, with white drapes overhead

story: On 28 March 2026, Midnight Children and Green Live Events turned The Warehouse at Emperors Palace upside down. Wonderland was an invitation to step through the keyhole: eight hours, from 4pm to midnight, of bass, visuals and a room dressed like a dream that had lost track of gravity.

Chairs, lampshades and flowers hung from the ceiling, a jungle garden waited by the entrance, and the dress code was simply “as curious as you dare”. The guests took it seriously: bunny ears, Mad Hatter top hats, a Joker and his Harley.

Under the glowing Midnight Children sign, TiMO ODV (live) and Aidin Caye hosted the night with Skelm, a live saxophone soaring over the top as the floor filled up and the lights went deep red and blue.
